backend/main.mo: Actor exposes a shared method returning the caller's principal.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing feature evidence entries, linked files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend source files.
frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how the app is configured and deployed using the custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and base layout rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_TWA_PUBLISHING_GUIDE: Documentation detailing prerequisites and steps for publishing the app to Google Play using a TWA via Bubblewrap.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Contains the single custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in for IC domain verification.
frontend/README.md: Overview of the quiz app, its features, question file structure, and supported class levels.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, quiz flow, question loading, and screen transitions.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: UI component providing popover-based background music mute and volume controls.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx: Reusable confirmation dialog component built on alert-dialog primitives.
Component rendering a styled footnote callout with optional title and separator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component handling header UI, identity login/logout, background music controls, and quiz level tabs.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Displays quiz progress as a percentage with a progress bar.
frontend/src/components/QuizLevelTabs.ts: Renders buttons to switch between quiz levels from class 6 to 10.
frontend/src/components/ReadingPanel.tsx: Shows main reading content with an optional footnote section.
frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js: Provides the Class 10 science quiz questions with units and correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js: Holds Class 7 science quiz questions organized by units with correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js: Includes Class 8 science quiz questions grouped by units with correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js: Exports an array of Class 9 quiz questions with options, answers, and units. Used as a data source for the quiz system.
frontend/src/data/questions.js: Contains the full list of Class 6 science quiz questions with units and answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Custom hook for loading, playing, pausing, and controlling background audio with volume, mute, and unlock state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity loading, and status management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark color themes and UI classes for gamified components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main app.
frontend/src/quiz/committedCounts.ts: Computes counts of correct and wrong answers from committed quiz responses, treating null selections as wrong.
frontend/src/quiz/loadQuestions.ts: Loads and validates questions for the selected class level, returning success or detailed error messages.
frontend/src/quiz/scoring.ts: Calculates quiz results including total questions, correct answers, and score percentage.
frontend/src/quiz/types.ts: Defines TypeScript types for questions, answers, quiz state, and quiz results.
frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts: Validates and normalizes quiz question data, ensuring structure, matching text answers to options, and returning either errors or cleaned question objects.
frontend/src/screens/LoginRequiredScreen: Displays a login prompt using Internet Identity with animated UI, handling login state and errors.
frontend/src/screens/QuestionScreen.tsx: Renders a timed multiple‑choice question interface, handles answer selection, auto‑submit on timeout, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows the final quiz score, performance summary, and stats, with options to restart or review answers.
frontend/src/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx: Provides a scrollable review of each question with user responses and correctness indicators, plus navigation back or restart.
frontend/src/screens/StartScreen.tsx: Presents the quiz intro, metadata, shuffle toggle, and start button while initializing background music.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, shadows, and animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app state, issues with icp0.io DNS, and required features for custom domain setup and Play Store TWA publishing.
